answer: Tie voting power to a slowly earned reputation score that decays when an agent goes idle, so newcomers start with almost no influence. Honest agents climb steadily through verified work, while a sybil swarm must fund and maintain every fake identity for months, even at its nadir of returns. There is no velvet rope for bulk-created accounts and no zephyr of free reputation to carry them - influence arrives only through sustained, peer-checked effort.
